info.title: DEMS Core API
info.summary: Core API v1 of the DEMS Edge Client demo: one live endpoint on the local mock-core, nine simulated in the browser.
info.description:
Reference for the Core API v1 of the **DEMS Edge Client demo** (device DEMS-IR-01). The design book (§21.2) names nine endpoints; this document adds their request and response bodies, plus the local service-liveness endpoint.

### Live and simulated

| Badge | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **LIVE** | Served over the network by mock-core at `http://127.0.0.1:4400`. |
| **SIMULATED** | Answered in the browser by the demo simulator. Responses carry `x-dems-simulated: 1`; no request leaves the machine. |
| **RBAC + AUDIT** | The simulator checks the role of the operator signed in to this console and writes a tamper-evident audit row. |

Every operation also states `x-dems-mode: live` or `x-dems-mode: simulated`.

### Not defined in the design book

The design book names the endpoint concepts only. It does not define:
- authentication or login, pairing, metadata submission, evidence list, audit list or verification endpoints (left out here on purpose);
- a WebSocket path or message schema (`/ws` and the heartbeat message are this demo's choice; see the Realtime tag);
- request or response bodies (every body in this document is a demo definition);
- an authentication scheme (the simulated endpoints act as the operator signed in to this console).

### Examples

Examples are frozen at 2026-10-01 10:00:00 WIB and follow the canonical demo dataset: session SES-20261001-0024 (case LP/2026/1001-0007, 00:18:42 into the recording) and evidence EV-20260930-0004, exported by the SUPERVISOR operator. Simulated responses write times at UTC+07:00 (WIB); mock-core writes UTC. The live simulator dates IDs from its own clock, so only the date part differs from these examples. All data is synthetic.

servers.description: Local mock-core. It serves GET /api/v1/health and WS /ws; the simulated endpoints are answered in the browser.

tags.name: Realtime
tags.description:
**LIVE** WebSocket `ws://127.0.0.1:4400/ws` served by mock-core. OpenAPI 3.1 cannot describe a socket, so it is documented here and shown live in the Realtime panel next to this reference.

- Server to client only: one JSON `Heartbeat` message (see the Heartbeat model) per text frame every 1000 ms, plus one immediately after connecting.
- `seq` counts ticks since the server started. `sessionState` is `null` in this demo phase.
- Upgrades from origins other than the web dev origins and the service's own origins are refused with 403.
- Clients show the link as STALE after 2500 ms without a heartbeat and reconnect after 0.5 s, 1 s, 2 s, 4 s, 8 s (the last delay repeats), plus up to 250 ms of jitter.
- Messages sent by clients are ignored.

Example message:

```json
{
  "type": "heartbeat",
  "v": 1,
  "seq": 5400,
  "serverTime": "2026-10-01T03:00:00.000Z",
  "uptimeMs": 5400012,
  "intervalMs": 1000,
  "clients": 2,
  "sessionState": null
}
```

post.description:
Creates a session and returns its Session ID; the session enters **CREATE** (book §6.2, §12.2 steps 1-2).

Idempotent (S26): the same input while that session is still open returns it with `200` and `created: false`.

Requires a signed-in operator holding SESSION_START; writes the SESSION_CREATED audit row.

Simulated: "Try it" is answered in the browser by the demo simulator (header `x-dems-simulated: 1`). Nothing leaves the machine.

200.description: The same input was already created: the open session is returned.

replay.summary: Same input again: the open session

400.description: The body is not a JSON object (INVALID_JSON).

error.message: The request body must be a JSON object.

422.description: The input is incomplete or invalid (INVALID_INPUT).

post.description:
Runs the Core pre-check (book §5.3: 8 checks) and starts recording.

- From **CREATE**: begins the pre-check and answers `202` with state **PRECHECK**. Poll `GET /api/v1/session/current` and call again once it is **ARMED**.
- From **ARMED**: starts recording and answers `200` with state **RECORDING**.
- Pre-check ended with **WARN**: send `{"acknowledgeWarnings": true}` to acknowledge and start; without it the answer is `409 PRECHECK_WARNINGS`.
- Pre-check with a **BLOCK** (Core offline, lens fault, storage full, security fault): `409 PRECHECK_BLOCKED` with the reasons.

Requires a signed-in operator holding SESSION_START; the audit rows name that operator.

Simulated: "Try it" is answered in the browser by the demo simulator (header `x-dems-simulated: 1`). Nothing leaves the machine.

post.description:
Stops the recording with a mandatory reason and moves the session to finalization: **STOPPING** → **FINALIZING** (hashes, manifest, encryption, signature) → **SEALED** (book §6.2, §12.2 steps 5-10).

Answers `202` at STOPPING; poll `GET /api/v1/session/current` for the seal.

Requires a signed-in operator holding SESSION_START; the RECORDING_STOPPED row names that operator.

Simulated: "Try it" is answered in the browser by the demo simulator (header `x-dems-simulated: 1`). Nothing leaves the machine.

post.description:
**RBAC + audit required** (book §19.3, §21.2). The simulator applies the role of the operator signed in to this console; the design book defines no authentication endpoint, so no token travels on the wire.

- SUPERVISOR (holds EVIDENCE_EXPORT): `202`, and an EVIDENCE_EXPORTED audit row (the ExportEvent).
- INVESTIGATOR or TECHNICIAN: `403 FORBIDDEN`, and an EXPORT_DENIED audit row (EVT-26).

Only SEALED, UNDER_REVIEW or EXPORTED evidence can be exported, and the sealed source is never modified (book §19.3 rule 1).

Simulated: "Try it" is answered in the browser by the demo simulator (header `x-dems-simulated: 1`). Nothing leaves the machine.

400.description: The body is not a JSON object (INVALID_JSON).

error.message: The request body must be a JSON object.

403.description: The role lacks EVIDENCE_EXPORT (FORBIDDEN); an EXPORT_DENIED audit row is written.

error.message: Your role cannot export evidence (RBAC). The attempt was audited.

409.description: The evidence is not sealed, or security is in FAULT (NOT_SEALED, SECURITY_FAULT).

error.message: Only sealed evidence can be exported.

422.description: The reason is shorter than 5 characters (INVALID_REASON).

error.message: An export reason of at least 5 characters is required.

value.reason: Case file handover for prosecutor review

subjectType.description: Subject type, Indonesian terms verbatim: TERSANGKA (suspect), SAKSI (witness), LAINNYA (other).

subjectName.description: Subject or witness name (book §11.3 field 4). Synthetic in the demo.

investigatorId.description: Operator ID of the investigator (book §11.3 field 3), e.g. `OPR-001`. The simulator also requires that the operator exists and holds SESSION_START.

room.description: Room or location. The form defaults to "Interview Room 1".

profileId.description: Recording profile. STANDARD_1080P25 = "Standard (1080p / 25 fps)", H.264, 2 video + 2 audio tracks.

SessionCreateRequest.description: Session Info (step 1 of Start New Session). The request body of `POST /api/v1/session`.

acknowledgeWarnings.description: Send `true` to acknowledge a pre-check that ended with WARN and start recording.

reason.description: Why the recording stops (at least 5 characters after trimming; S21).

state.description: The session state after the command.

created.description: Create only: false when the same input returned the open session (S26).

SessionCommandResponse.description: Result of a session command (create, start, stop).

value.description: Live device state, e.g. ONLINE, READY, NO_SIGNAL, GNSS.

reason.description: Why the check warns or blocks.

PrecheckItem.description: One of the 8 book §5.3 pre-recording checks.

id.description: Session ID `SES-{YYYYMMDD}-NNNN` (the sim clock date, UTC+07:00).

state.description: Book §6.2 state. FAULT and RECOVERY are demo assumptions (01 G4).

caseNumber.description: Case reference, `LP/YYYY/MMDD-NNNN` when created through the form.

investigatorName.description: Rank and name, e.g. "AKP Budi Santoso".

elapsedMs.description: Recording time so far (0 before RECORDING), derived from the clock.

evidenceId.description: Set once finalization creates the evidence object.

fault.description: The critical fault that moved the session to FAULT, if any.

session.description: Null when no session is open (IDLE).

CurrentSessionResponse.description: Response of `GET /api/v1/session/current` (the tablet resynchronises with it after a reconnect, book §5.6).

dbfs.description: Ballistic level in dBFS; -90 means no signal.

peak.description: Peak hold in dBFS (1.5 s, then 20 dB/s decay).

AudioChannelStatus.description: One audio channel (AUDIO-01 = MIC 1, AUDIO-02 = MIC 2).

AudioStatusResponse.description: Per-channel audio snapshot. Meters use it as their initial value; live levels run at 20 Hz in-process.

state.description: READY, LOW (≥ 85 % used) or FULL (≥ 98 % used); the thresholds are demo assumptions (G8).

StorageStatusResponse.description: Storage capacity and health, including the LOW and FULL states.

flags.description: What makes the state ATTENTION or CRITICAL.

source.description: Active source, priority GNSS → NTP → RTC.

DeviceHealthResponse.description: Device health snapshot: camera, audio, storage, time and security, plus services.

reason.description: Purpose of the export (book §19.2 item 8; at least 5 characters after trimming).

destination.description: Destination or approved media identifier (book §19.2 item 6). Empty means "Case file transfer (simulated)"; text beyond 120 characters is cut.

EvidenceExportAccepted.description: Export accepted. The ExportEvent (book §19.2: operator, time, destination, reason) is the EVIDENCE_EXPORTED audit row it wrote.

code.description: Machine-readable code: INVALID_JSON, NOT_SIGNED_IN, NOT_PERMITTED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED, SESSION_ACTIVE, INVALID_INPUT, INVALID_STATE, PRECHECK_RUNNING, PRECHECK_WARNINGS, PRECHECK_BLOCKED, INVALID_REASON, NOT_SEALED, SECURITY_FAULT, SIMULATOR_ERROR.

message.description: Operator-safe English text. Never contains credentials.

ApiError.description: Error body of every 4xx and 5xx response.

XDemsSimulated.description: Present on every simulated response: the in-browser simulator answered, not the network.
